[[Reng Ku]] is the initial trainer for [[Necromancer]]s (either as a primary or secondary profession) at the [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. He is [[Headmaster Kuju]]'s grandson and [[Su]]'s brother.

==Dialogue==
'''If your character is a Necromancer:'''
:''"So you have chosen the path of the Necromancer, also. Well, you will soon learn that life is all about death. And pain. And sadness. Well, I suppose I am your teacher for the time being. What do you need of me?"''
'''If your character is not a Necromancer:'''
:''"You are not a Necromancer, so there is nothing I can do for you. I trust you can find your own trainer."''
